answer: Give every identity a public atlas of completed, paid work that grows only by doing real jobs: each entry is signed by the client who paid for it, with the amount and outcome on record. A fresh identity starts with an empty atlas and earns trust the way a cedar grows, slowly, one verified ring at a time, so a sybil operator cannot simply wander in with a thousand new names. Cloning one agent means redoing every paid job from scratch: faking 100 identities costs 100 full work histories, while one caught forgery burns the whole atlas.
